name: Beef Stroganoff
recipeIngredient: 600 g / 1.2 lb   scotch fillet steak / boneless rib eye ((Note 1))
1/2 tsp cooking salt / kosher salt ((halve for table salt, +50% for flakes))
300 g / 10 oz   mushrooms (, sliced (not too thin))
2 cups beef broth (, preferably salt reduced)
250 - 300 g / 8 - 10 oz   pasta or egg noodles of choice ((Note 3))

recipeInstructions.text: Pound and slice - Use your fist (or rolling pin or mallet) to flatten the steaks to about 3/4cm / 1/3" thick. Slice into 5mm / 1/5" strips (cut long ones in half), discarding excess fat.
recipeInstructions.name: Pound and slice - Use your fist (or rolling pin or mallet) to flatten the steaks to about 3/4cm / 1/3" thick. Slice into 5mm / 1/5" strips (cut long ones in half), discarding excess fat.

recipeInstructions.text: Sprinkle beef with the salt and pepper
recipeInstructions.name: Sprinkle beef with the salt and pepper

recipeInstructions.text: 30 second sear - Heat 1 tablespoon of the oil in a large skillet over high heat. Scatter half the beef in the skillet, QUICKLY spread it with tongs. Leave untouched for 30 seconds until browned. Turn beef quickly (as best you can!). Leave untouched for 30 seconds to brown. Immediately remove onto a plate. Don't worry about pink bits and that it will be raw inside.

recipeInstructions.text: Repeat - Add remaining 1 tablespoon of oil and repeat with remaining beef, removing onto the same plate once cooked.
recipeInstructions.name: Repeat - Add remaining 1 tablespoon of oil and repeat with remaining beef, removing onto the same plate once cooked.

recipeInstructions.text: Sauté onion and mushrooms - Turn heat down to medium high. Using the same pan, add butter and melt. Then add onions, cook for 1 minute, then add mushrooms. Cook mushrooms until golden. Scrape bottom of fry pan to get all the golden bits off (this is flavour!).
recipeInstructions.name: Sauté onion and mushrooms - Turn heat down to medium high. Using the same pan, add butter and melt. Then add onions, cook for 1 minute, then add mushrooms. Cook mushrooms until golden. Scrape bottom of fry pan to get all the golden bits off (this is flavour!).

recipeInstructions.text: Add flour and cook, stirring, for 1 minute.
recipeInstructions.name: Add flour and cook, stirring, for 1 minute.

recipeInstructions.text: Add stock/broth - Add half the broth while stirring. Once incorporated into the flour mixture, add remaining broth.
recipeInstructions.name: Add stock/broth - Add half the broth while stirring. Once incorporated into the flour mixture, add remaining broth.

recipeInstructions.text: Make sauce - Stir, then add sour cream and mustard. Stir until incorporated (don't worry if it looks split, sour cream will "melt" as it heats). Bring to simmer ,then reduce heat to medium low. Once it thickens to the consistency of pouring cream (3 - 5 minutes), have a taste and add more salt and pepper to taste.

recipeInstructions.text: Warm beef - Add beef back in (including plate juices). Simmer for 1 minute, then remove from stove immediately. (Note 4)

recipeInstructions.text: Serve over pasta or egg noodles, sprinkled with chives if desired.
